property_summary: For every call to forward(callee, data), the reference C must actually invoke the external callee with the supplied calldata, so the callee's recorded call count is 1 and its recorded calldata equals the supplied data; the mutant replaces the call with a no-op and therefore performs no external call, leaving the recorded call count at 0 and calldata empty.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a successful no-op, so forward no longer makes the external call.
